latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Video in Filmora" skill for fast, AI-powered video editing.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV files up to 500MB for server-side editing and export.
- Users can request trims, transitions, color correction, and more—AI handles editing based on instructions.
- Seamless cloud rendering delivers polished video (MP4, up to 1080p) in 1–2 minutes.
- Built-in flow for session management, credit checks, and friendly status updates.
- Ideal for content creators and casual editors who want quick, professional results without complicated software.
